parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom structural part of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing stability and support for the entire structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and the items stored inside, ensuring balance and rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of MDF, attached with hinges to allow access to the cabinet interior.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the storage space and protects the contents from dust and external exposure.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main body structure of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and shape.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all other parts together, including the door, shelves, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s overall integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structural component and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board, used for organizing stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a flat surface for placing items within the cabinet, dividing the internal space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is another horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board, supporting heavier items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space and supports heavier objects placed at the bottom of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but remains stationary during normal use.
